title: migrate pr-delivery to contract v2
goal: Adopt result_contract:2 in the pr-delivery plugin: v2 result file on every exit path, valid_verdicts declared, input paths from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, rc∈{0,1}, provides.events and provides.result_contract in manifest.

steps.description: Write a failing unit test (TDD first) covering all acceptance-criteria SPECs: manifest provides.result_contract:2, valid_verdicts=[pass,error], provides.events declared, provides.role:pr, primary:true on pr_url, hooks has no cleanup:; plugin writes result_contract:2+verdict+disposition+reason on every exit path (block, dry-run, merge-delegation, pr-open-delegation, fallback-gh-fail); all exit paths return rc∈{0,1}; plugin.sh constructs no input artifact paths (grep assertion); inputs resolved via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS. Confirm it FAILS at the merge-base before touching any implementation file. State the red step and how it failed in the PR body.

Update plugins/agent/pr-delivery/manifest.yaml: add result_contract:2 under provides:; add events: list under provides: (at minimum pr.delivery.blocked, pr.delivery.opened, pr.delivery.dry_run); update valid_verdicts from [] to [pass, error]; verify primary:true on pr_url output and role:pr are already present (no change needed); confirm hooks has only run: and no cleanup: (already correct — record that cleanup is absent because the plugin holds no live resources). No router: block added because pr-delivery makes no direct LLM calls.

Update plugins/agent/pr-delivery/plugin.sh: (a) add _pr_delivery_write_result <artifact_dir> <verdict> <disposition> <reason> helper that writes pr-result.json with {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{branch, ...}}; (b) resolve declared inputs (review_report → review-report.json; gate_aggregator_result) from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS via jq lookup instead of constructing $artifacts_dir/<name>.json paths — the legacy review.json block guard is updated to use the resolved path or removed since review_report supersedes it; (c) change the missing-state-file path from return 2 to return 1; (d) call _pr_delivery_write_result on every terminal exit path with the appropriate verdict (pass/error), disposition (complete for expected outcomes, unavailable for failed external actions), and reason string; (e) carry the delegated plugin's disposition when merge_run or pr_open_run returns non-zero (read .disposition from their result file).

Update the existing integration test to add v2 assertions: for SPEC-3 (dry-run), SPEC-4 (block guard), and SPEC-5 (pr-open delegation), assert that pr-result.json carries result_contract:2, a non-empty verdict, a non-empty disposition, and a non-empty reason — confirming behaviour is unchanged for a passing run while the result envelope is richer. These are additive assertions on the existing SPECs; no existing assertion is removed. This satisfies the 'before/after golden diff on the stage's own output' acceptance criterion.

Run npm test (full suite) with the tree committed so mutation coverage engages. Fix any shellcheck or contract-validator failures. Verify the new unit test and updated integration test are both green. Confirm the unit test was red at the merge-base (per step-1) by noting the assertion and failure mode in the PR description.

notes:
1. Router block: pr-delivery makes no direct LLM calls — it delegates to merge and pr-open which carry their own router config. The acceptance criterion 'Router budgets resolve from the manifest' therefore requires no router: block here; this is noted rather than silently omitted.
2. The legacy review.json input path ($artifacts_dir/review.json) is NOT a declared manifest input (the manifest comment explains it was dropped when stage:review was retired). The migration removes this hardcoded path entirely; the review_report input (review-report.json) is the surviving declared input and is resolved via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS.
3. valid_verdicts: the plugin emits pass (all success paths) and error (block guard, delegation failure, missing state_file, fallback-gh failure). There is no 'skip' verdict — the current dry_run path writes status:dry_run in the data field but the verdict is pass. This matches the design/merge pattern of [pass, error].
4. provides.events: the plugin emits no event_emit calls today. Under v2 the manifest declares the events it COULD emit; at minimum pr.delivery.blocked (review block guard), pr.delivery.opened, pr.delivery.dry_run are declared so the event-schema validator accepts them. If the plugin does not yet emit these, the declaration is still required by #1717.
5. Golden diff (acceptance criterion 5): covered by the additive assertions in step-4 rather than a separate golden fixture, because the stage's output shape changes (pr-result.json gains result_contract/disposition/reason) — a frozen golden would fail on the new fields. The before/after comparison is expressed as per-field assertions.
6. The 'Reddens at the merge-base' DoD item is satisfied by step-1: the unit test is written first, confirmed red, and the PR body states the assertion and failure mode.
7. Coverage floor: adding tests/unit/pr-delivery-v2-result-test.sh and touching plugin.sh/manifest.yaml does not introduce untested .sh files; the new test sources and exercises the updated plugin.sh directly, so the denominator does not grow without numerator coverage.
